Spacing rhythm

8 · 16 · 24 · 32 · 48 px

2 px corners · Buttons at least 48 px tall

Less noise. More intent.

These principles keep the world consistent
across every screen and state.

Light follows action

Cyan marks the gesture path, active tracking, and feedback. The background leaves the target in focus.

Every detail has a purpose

The arc defines the gesture space. The dot marks its start. The diamond marks its end. Ornament keeps controls clear.

Words guide action

“Show your whole hand” gives a clear next step. Explain the cause, then show how to recover.

Motion respects attention

Feedback is brief and steady. Reduced motion preferences turn animations off.
